name: halana_and_alena_negative_power_puts_no_counters
notes: Was a known bug (M5 mapper, 2026-11-17), fixed by engine wave E2: every number an effect uses goes through selectors.effect_number, CR 107.1b's clamp at 0. Played on the unverified FDN record (tools/scenarios/mapped). Printed: 'At the beginning of combat on your turn, put X +1/+1 counters on another target creature you control, where X is Halana and Alena's power.' CR 107.1b: a negative X is 0. verbs._v_put_counter adds the computed count as it is, so a negative count removes counters (or leaves a negative count). Halana and Alena (2/3) get +0/+3 (Dive Down) and -2/-2 twice (two Stabs): -2/2. At the beginning of combat the trigger targets the Bear, which has three +1/+1 counters: expected, no counter put and three kept; today two are removed (one left). Weaker than printed (it only targets a creature its controller controls).
